capabilities: Browse SQLite tables and schemas in a dedicated view
Run read-only SELECT queries with configurable row limits
Embed live query results in notes via sqlite-query code blocks
Convert live query blocks into static Markdown table snapshots
Export result grids as CSV or Markdown
extras: Desktop-only. Strictly read-only: the database is loaded into memory and never written back to disk. Architecture details are deferred to a separate ARCHITECTURE.md.
problem: Obsidian cannot open or display SQLite database files stored in a vault, so users must leave the app to inspect or query them.

relations.evidence: The plugin uses sql.js (SQLite compiled to WebAssembly) rather than native bindings

summary: SQLite database browser that opens .sqlite/.db files from the vault, inspects tables and schemas, and embeds read-only query results in notes.
